title_en: Patta transfer and patta / chitta copy online
department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department (Survey and Settlement), Government of Tamil Nadu
what_it_is: Patta is the land record in your name. On the land records e-service you can apply for patta transfer, and view patta, chitta and land sketches (FMB) online. You do not need to visit a Revenue office to see this information.
who_can_apply: Any citizen can apply for patta transfer.
documents: A registered deed: sale deed, settlement deed, partition deed or gift deed
how_to_apply: To change the patta, apply online for patta transfer, or go to a Common Service Centre (e-Sevai). There are two kinds: without subdivision and with subdivision of the land. To see your patta or chitta, open the land records e-service and choose 'View Patta / Chitta'. You can check your application status online.
where_to_apply: Online at eservices.tn.gov.in or the Tamil Nilam citizen portal, or at any Common Service Centre in Tamil Nadu.
fee: Rs 60 processing fee for a patta transfer application (with or without subdivision), at a Common Service Centre or the citizen portal. For subdivision, a further rate per subdivision: Rs 400 rural, Rs 500 urban, Rs 600 corporation areas (G.O.(Ms) No.370, 21.07.2020). Field Measurement Sketch copies can be downloaded free.
